parsed.notes:
Section 'Was du bewegst' is responsibilities; CI/CD appears only there, so it is not labeled.
'Was dich auszeichnet' is the requirements section and defaults to required.
Azure DevOps is a Microsoft product (repos/pipelines), not the DevOps practice. I put it in unmapped rather than mapping it to devops; it is required in the daily-toolkit bullet.
The azure label is required from the daily-toolkit and IaC bullets.
Entra ID is the renamed Azure Active Directory, so I mapped it to active-directory. Flagged uncertain.
The 'Idealerweise' bullet (the 'ideally' marker) makes the Azure AI stack items nice_to_have.
Azure OpenAI is mapped to openai-api. Flagged uncertain because it is the Azure-hosted variant.
'von Vorteil' (is an advantage) makes LLMs and RAG nice_to_have.
Terraform and Azure DevOps are also named in the requirements bullets, so they stay required.
The posting is in German and says nothing about language, so German is required with basis inferred.
'oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation' counts as comparable qualification, so degree_or_equivalent is true.
There are no years of experience and no level words, so seniority is none.
